intro: 12 個晉升、退休金與獎勵情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: Your main achievements will be listed in your personnel file.
ex.zh: 你的主要成就會列入你的人事檔案。

ex.en: Joseph's achievements in R&D will go down in company history.
ex.zh: 約瑟夫在研發部門的成就將會載入公司史冊。

note: a sense of achievement 成就感
achieve 達成;achiever 有成就的人

ex.en: Make sure your boss is aware of the work you contributed to the project.
ex.zh: 務必讓你的老闆知道你為這個專案貢獻了哪些工作。

ex.en: All employees are asked to contribute a few minutes of their spare time to clean up the office.
ex.zh: 所有員工都被要求撥出幾分鐘空閒時間來打掃辦公室。

note: contribute to sth 對⋯有貢獻;contribute A to B 把 A 貢獻給 B

ex.en: The director's dedication to a high-quality product has motivated many of his employees.
ex.zh: 主管對高品質產品的投入,激勵了許多員工。

ex.en: We would never be where we are today if it weren't for many long hours and so much dedication.
ex.zh: 要不是有許多長時間的付出與無比的奉獻,我們不會有今天的成就。

note: dedication to sth 對⋯的奉獻
dedicate 奉獻;dedicated 專注投入的

ex.en: The regional director was looking forward to the new, larger offices.
ex.zh: 區域主管期待著新的、更大的辦公室。

ex.en: We look forward to seeing you at the next meeting.
ex.zh: 我們期待在下次會議上見到你。

note: to 是介系詞,後接 V-ing 或名詞,不接原形動詞

ex.en: The workers always looked to him to settle their disagreements.
ex.zh: 員工們總是倚賴他來調解彼此的紛爭。

ex.en: The staff is looking to their supervisor for guidance and direction.
ex.zh: 員工們指望主管提供指引與方向。

note: look to sb for sth 指望某人提供⋯

ex.en: You have been such a loyal advisor for so many years, I'm not sure what I'll do without you.
ex.zh: 你這麼多年來一直是如此忠實的顧問,我不知道沒有你我該怎麼辦。

ex.en: Even though your assistant is loyal, you have to question his job performance.
ex.zh: 即使你的助理很忠誠,你還是得質疑他的工作表現。

note: be loyal to sb / sth 對⋯忠誠
loyalty 忠誠;反義 disloyal 不忠的

ex.en: Employees are evaluated on their merit and not on seniority.
ex.zh: 員工是依據優異的表現來評量,而不是依年資。

ex.en: Your work has improved tremendously and is of great merit.
ex.zh: 你的工作表現進步極大,非常出色。

note: on merit 依功績;merit-based 以功績為基礎的
seniority 年資,與 merit 常成對比

ex.en: Her tardiness was obviously resented by her coworkers.
ex.zh: 她的遲到顯然讓同事們很不滿。

ex.en: He was obviously working hard to get the promotion.
ex.zh: 他顯然為了爭取升遷而努力工作。

ex.en: John received a lot of praise for the article he wrote about business trends.
ex.zh: 約翰寫的商業趨勢文章獲得許多讚賞。

ex.en: It never hurts to praise an employee for a job well done.
ex.zh: 稱讚員工把工作做得很好,從來沒有壞處。

note: praise sb for sth 因⋯稱讚某人;in praise of 讚揚

ex.en: Even though the sales associate had a good year, it wasn't possible to promote him.
ex.zh: 儘管這位業務專員這一年表現很好,但還是不可能晉升他。

ex.en: The assistant director promoted the idea that the director was incompetent.
ex.zh: 副主管大力宣揚主管不稱職的說法。

note: promotion 晉升、促銷;promoter 發起人

ex.en: The president's assistant was finally given the recognition that she has deserved for many years.
ex.zh: 總裁助理終於得到她多年來應得的肯定。

ex.en: Recognition of excellent work should be routine for every manager.
ex.zh: 肯定優秀的工作表現,應該成為每位主管的例行公事。

note: in recognition of 為表彰⋯;gain recognition 受到肯定

ex.en: Employees value their colleagues' opinions.
ex.zh: 員工重視同事的意見。

ex.en: The expert valued the text at $7,000.
ex.zh: 專家把這份文稿估價為七千美元。

note: valuable 貴重的;valued 受重視的;invaluable 無價的
